title: One player is different
text: Everyone answers the same question, except one player whose phone shows a different one.

scene.phone: How many hours do you sleep?
How many pets have you had?
scene.label: The odd one

title: Answers go up
text: All the answers appear on the TV. Talk it over: whose answer doesn't fit?

title: Vote
text: Everyone votes for who they think got the different question.

title: Scoring
text: Points for spotting the odd one. The odd one scores for every player they fooled, and a bonus for escaping.
